## Title
类型：简洁、准确地概括PR的核心更改

e.g. feat:添加xxx模块

类型参考以下：**Change Type (select all)**



### Change Type (select all)

- [ ] 错误修复 (Bug fix)
- [ ] 功能添加 (Feature)
- [ ] 代码重构 (Refactor)
- [ ] 性能优化 (Performance)
- [ ] 测试添加/修改 (Tests)
- [ ] 文档改进 (Docs)
- [ ] 依赖更新 (Dependencies)
- [ ] 样式/格式化 (Style)
- [ ] 其他 (Others)

## Linked Issue/PR

- Closes #
- Related #
- Fixes #

## Summary

Describe the problem and fix in 2–5 bullets:

- Problem:
- Why it matters:
- What changed:
- What did NOT change (scope boundary):

## Evidence

Attach at least one:

- [ ] Failing test/log before + passing after
- [ ] Trace/log snippets
- [ ] Screenshot/recording
- [ ] Perf numbers (if relevant)
